neighbours.label: the token 'take' in any inflection (take/takes/took/taken/taking), in any sense, including when it opens a longer word or name (e.g. Takeshita); synonyms without the word stay silent
neighbours.notes: Step mission: feeder of bonsai1/L4/N9247- (play step drop 0.19). Lexical, not semantic: seize/steal/snatch/grab/accept are ~0; 'take care', 'my take', 'the vaccine didn't take' all fire. Inverse solver leak: surname 'Takeshita' (tokenized ' Takes'+'hita') fires 0.97, so the label is token-level. Compounds where take is mid-word (intake, takeover, retake) are partial (0.2-0.3), so they are avoided in both lists. The + pole is weak (max 0.25) and broad (digit 8, Russian 'Иван'); not labelled here.
